title: V-Order, OPTIMIZE and VACUUM
objectives: Explain why many small files slow every reader
Say what OPTIMIZE and V-Order do to a Delta table's files
Work out which files VACUUM may delete, and why the retention period matters

exercises.prompt: delta_files lists a table's data files from its Delta log. How many current files (not removed) are under 32 MB? One column, small_files.
hints: The starter counts removed files too. A removed file is still on disk until VACUUM, but readers skip it.
Count rows WHERE removed_on IS NULL AND size_mb < 32.

exercises.prompt: VACUUM runs on 2026-11-02 with the default 7-day (168-hour) retention. List the file_name of every file it would delete, in file_name order.
hints: VACUUM only deletes files the log has removed, and only once they were removed longer ago than the retention.
removed_on IS NOT NULL AND removed_on < DATE '2026-10-26'
